about: One table, two parsers. A page asks for a library with an empty `<script data-canvas-lib="NAME"></script>`, and the host (plugin/canvases.py, `_library_asks`) and the app (app/src/lib/canvas-document.ts, `canvasLibraryPlan`) have to read the same tags as asks and name them the same, or the host refuses a tag the app would have answered. `asks` is what both must answer for `html`. `stored` marks a document a version may already hold from before the host refused a name: it still opens and draws.

cases.case: an ask with other attributes, a quoted `>`, and either quote style
an ask with content in it is the page's own script, not an ask
an ask inside a comment is no ask
either quote style, in document order
extra whitespace around the name and inside the tag
a name this host does not carry
a version stored before this rule, naming a library the host no longer carries
an empty `<!-->` before an ask is a complete comment, and the ask stands
a page's own script whose text holds a comment opener
a style's text holding a comment opener
